description: This file contains the implementation of ApplicationClientFactory for Hono clients, specifically the ApplicationClientFactoryImpl class. It defines methods for creating and managing various message consumers and command clients within the Hono framework, including handling connection lifecycle events.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements the ApplicationClientFactory interface, providing methods to create message consumers and manage command clients.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer for a given tenant, using provided message handler and close handler.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates an event message consumer for a tenant with specified message handler and close handler.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for a tenant, with optional replyId.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for a tenant.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for asynchronous command responses, with message handling and close handling.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup of client factories on disconnect.
